premises.text: Dynamic pricing by stores leads to consumers paying more without realizing it
premises.evidence_span: stores are taking advantage of this psychology by changing prices, by getting you to pay more without you realizing it

premises.text: Stores change prices rapidly and less transparently than before
premises.evidence_span: They're changing prices faster and faster and less transparently than ever before

premises.text: Consumers are leaving significant amounts of money unclaimed due to complex refund processes
premises.evidence_span: we estimate that online consumers are leaving $10 billion on the table every year

premises.text: Paribus automates the process of claiming refunds for price drops
premises.evidence_span: Paribus is a web app that gets you the money you're owed effortlessly

premises.text: Paribus uses algorithms to track purchases and file claims automatically
premises.evidence_span: we'll use a combination of price scraping, coupon detection algorithms, and keep finding ways to save you money

premises.text: Paribus ensures user information is secure while processing claims
premises.evidence_span: Paribus does not live in your inbox

value.text: Consumers can effortlessly reclaim money from price drops

notes: No separate premises for user data security measures as they support the same premise.
